strings.l1_lesson2_step5_body: Dorong KEEMPAT manik bawah naik ke sekat tengah! Hitung: 1, 2, 3, 4! Ini angka terbesar dengan manik bawah saja!
strings.l1_rod_zero: %1$s: semua manik jauh dari sekat tengah

notes.l1_lesson1_step3_title: Title that introduces the bead: glossary long name 'manik atas (manik langit)' belongs here (English says 'Heaven' in full; same rule as vi 'hạt trên (hạt trời)'); body texts keep the short 'manik atas'
notes.l1_lesson1_step4_title: Same as step3: 'manik bawah (manik bumi)' once, in the introducing title only
notes.l1_lesson2_step5_body: 'SEMUA 4 manik' is a word-for-word calque; Indonesian says 'KEEMPAT manik bawah' for 'ALL 4 beads' (emphasis kept)
notes.l1_quiz_perfect: 'Kamu Bintang!' is truncated; the natural idiom is 'Kamu Bintangnya!'
notes.l1_rod_zero: Binding glossary rule: 'all beads down' is wrong for 0 (upper bead stays up); use 'all beads away from the beam', same wording as l1_lesson2_step1_body / l1_instr_zero
notes.l1_rod_heaven: 'hanya manik atas turun' lacks 'yang' (ungrammatical shorthand); 'hanya manik atas yang turun' matches l1_lesson5_step3_body
